s.t: For international shipments, which accounted for less than 10% of our consolidated sales in 2025, we ship via railcars and trucks to several ports where the product is loaded onto vessels for shipment to customers abroad.
During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, we had no customer that represented 10% or greater of consolidated sales.
During the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 the Company had no customer that represented 10% or greater of consolidated sales.

Each of our facilities is dependent on one or more key suppliers and the loss of any of these suppliers would adversely affect our financial results to the extent we were unable to find another supplier of this substantial amount of crude oil.
We believe that our employees are significant contributors to our success and the future success of our Company, which depends on our ability to attract, retain and motivate qualified personnel.

Our business depends on supply and demand fundamentals, which can be adversely affected by numerous macroeconomic factors outside of our control and which may in turn impact our operational and financial performance, including our ability to execute our business strategies in the expected time frame.
We rely on borrowings and letters of credit under our revolving credit facility to purchase feedstocks for our facilities for use in our operations.

We depend on certain third-party pipelines for transportation of feedstocks and products, and if these pipelines become unavailable to us, our revenues and cash available for payment of our debt obligations could decline.
Natural gas and utility costs constituted approximately 14.0% and 10.3% of our total operating expenses included in cost of sales for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.
We depend on unionized labor for the operation of many of our facilities.
We depend on key personnel for the success of our business and the loss of those persons could adversely affect our business and our ability to make payments of our debt obligations.
We depend on information technology systems to run our business.

We have a holding company structure in which our subsidiaries conduct our operations and own our operating assets and our ability to make payments of our debt obligations depends on the performance of our subsidiaries and their ability to distribute funds to us.
As a result, our ability to make payments of debt obligations depends on the performance of our subsidiaries and their ability to distribute funds to us.
Montana Renewables depends on the Company to provide MRL with services necessary to operate its business.
We rely on railroad and trucking companies to transport renewable feedstock materials to the Montana Renewables facility, and to deliver renewable transportation fuels to our customers.
For these reasons, investors should not rely on recent trends in the price of our common stock to predict the future price of our common stock or our future financial results.

Our future dividend policy is within the discretion of our board of directors and will depend upon various factors, including our results of operations, financial condition, capital requirements, investment opportunities, and restrictions under our debt agreements.

Our principal sources of cash have historically included cash flow from operations, proceeds from public equity offerings, proceeds from notes offerings, bank borrowings and other financial arrangements.
